title: Pro Plan Monthly API Rate Limit Increase
description: Pro plan monthly API rate limit increased from 10,000 to 25,000 requests per month.

title: Billing Tab Renamed to Subscriptions
description: The 'Plans' navigation tab in Billing settings has been renamed to 'Subscriptions'.

title: Retirement of Legacy Pro Tier
description: The Legacy Pro tier has been discontinued and replaced with Growth Plan.

after_state.details: All features migrated to Growth Plan

title: One-Click Bulk CSV Export
description: Manual row-by-row batch export script is replaced with a single 'Export All CSV' button in the dashboard toolbar.

before_state.details: Users previously had to run export script and download row by row

workflow_steps: click Export All CSV button in toolbar
after_state.details: Direct bulk export via dashboard toolbar

title: Attachment File Size Cap Expansion
description: Individual attachment file upload size increased from 5 MB to 25 MB.
